items.source: A particular element will match if it matches one of the elements in the includes list and does not match one of the elements in the excludes list.
items.translation: 如果某个元素匹配 `includes` 列表中的任一元素，且不匹配 `excludes` 列表中的任一元素，则该元素将匹配。

items.source: Subclasses may override match(Object, Object) to provide a custom matching algorithm.
items.translation: 子类可以重写match(Object, Object)以提供自定义的匹配算法。

items.source: See InstanceFilter(Collection, Collection, boolean) for details.
items.translation: 有关详细信息，请参阅InstanceFilter(Collection, Collection, boolean)。

items.source: Subclasses may redefine what matching means. By default, an element matches another if the two elements are equal.
items.translation: 子类可以重新定义匹配的含义。默认情况下，如果两个元素相等，则一个元素匹配另一个。

items.source: If both collections are empty, matchIfEmpty defines if an element matches or not.
items.translation: 如果两个集合都为空，matchIfEmpty 定义元素是否匹配。

items.source: By default, the two instances match if they are equal.
items.translation: 默认情况下，如果两个实例 相等，则它们匹配。

items.source: Determine if the specified instance matches this filter.
items.translation: 确定指定的instance是否与此过滤器匹配。

items.source: Determine if the specified instance matches one of the candidates.
items.translation: 确定指定的instance是否匹配其中一个候选项。

items.source: T - the instance type
items.translation: T - 实例类型

items.source: true if the instance matches; false if the candidates collection is empty or there is no match
items.translation: true 如果实例匹配；false 如果候选集合为空或没有匹配项。

items.source: includes - the collection of includes
items.translation: includes - 包含集合

items.source: excludes - the collection of excludes
items.translation: excludes - 排除集合

items.source: instance - the instance to check
items.translation: instance - 要检查的实例

items.source: candidates - the collection of candidates
items.translation: candidates - 候选者集合

items.source: Can be overridden by subclasses.
items.translation: 可被子类重写。

items.source: Create a new InstanceFilter based on include and exclude collections, with the matchIfEmpty flag set to true.
items.translation: 基于包含和排除集合创建一个新的InstanceFilter，并将matchIfEmpty标志设置为true。

items.source: Determine if the specified instance matches the specified candidate.
items.translation: 确定指定的instance是否与指定的candidate匹配。

items.source: Create a new InstanceFilter based on include and exclude collections.
items.translation: 基于包含和排除集合创建一个新的InstanceFilter。

items.source: toString in class Object
items.translation: `toString` 在类 `Object` 中

items.source: matchIfEmpty - the matching result if the includes and the excludes collections are both null or empty
items.translation: matchIfEmpty - 当包含和排除集合均为 null 或为空时的匹配结果

items.source: candidate - a candidate defined by this filter
items.translation: candidate - 由此过滤器定义的候选项

items.source: true if the instance matches the candidate
items.translation: true 表示该实例与候选项匹配。

items.source: Stephane Nicoll, Sam Brannen
items.translation: Stephane Nicoll, Sam Brannen
